name: incident-brief
title: Incident communication brief: draft
for_each: select id,code from events where kind='incident'

sections.title: Affected services
sections.sql: select c.name,c.status from event_components ec join components c on c.id=ec.component_id where ec.event_id=$1 order by c.name

sections.title: Recorded updates
sections.sql: select occurred_at,status,body from updates where event_id=$1 order by occurred_at,id
